notes: Push notifications now run on OneSignal, and the app can alert everyone about new chat messages and announcements.
new: Push notifications now use OneSignal. Turn them on in Settings, and they also work in the installed Android app.
New chat messages and announcements send an alert to the whole team automatically.
Each phone is linked to its account, with role tags (crew, oratory, priest, founder, admin), so alerts can be sent to just one group from the OneSignal dashboard.
changed: If notifications were already on, turn them on once more after this update.
